_about: Every logo position and its order, for the app and the admin portal. Change the order or the lead brand here, then run: python scripts/brand_sync.py. The logo files are used exactly as supplied (never recoloured, cropped, stretched or redrawn).
status: IHS leads (decision 2026-11-11); the other logos keep the order they were supplied in.

sarmaan_ii.label: SARMAAN-II Project
sarmaan_ii.note: Very small file: shown at most at its own pixel size, so it can be shorter than the others in a row until a vector file is supplied.

ihs.label: IHS Towers
ihs._clearSpaceRatio: width of the 'I' (275 px) / logo width (1668 px); clear space on every side

tabHeader._note: IHS alone at the top of the Home, Modules, Videos, Ask and About tabs. Smaller than the IHS 95 dp minimum by decision (2026-11-11): 36 dp high, 63 dp wide; minWidthDp 0 lifts the minimum for this placement only. Clear space stays the width of the 'I' at this size.

_placements_note: rowHeight is the target height for every logo in the row. A logo is never shown larger than its own pixels, and the IHS logo never narrower than 95 dp; rowHeightDp 54+ keeps IHS at 95 dp wide. The clear space between and around logos is the IHS rule (width of the 'I') at the row height. At 54 dp the four logos need about 380 dp; on narrower screens the row wraps onto a second line instead of shrinking a logo below its minimum.
